flight.title: Phase 2 · Zero-G Orbital Station Operations
flight.event.solarRepaired: Solar array servos aligned above 95% output efficiency
flight.event.thermalRepaired: Ammonia cooling loop flushed and thermal core stabilized
flight.event.oxygenRepaired: CO2 scrubber cartridge replaced and O2 pressure locked in nominal band
flight.event.docking1Success: East docking seal opened: Module 3 (Power & Cooling) hard-docked
flight.event.docking2Success: North docking seal opened: Module 4 (Life Support Shaft) hard-docked
flight.event.docking3Success: South docking seal opened: Module 5 (Command Bridge) hard-docked; satellite deployed
flight.failure.lowOrbit: Insufficient delta-v to reach target orbital altitude
flight.failure.overweight: Spacecraft wet mass exceeds launcher payload limit
flight.failure.solarTimeout: Solar array servo misaligned; station energy reserves critically depleted
flight.failure.thermalTimeout: Thermal runaway in power core damaged optical instrument payload
flight.failure.oxygenTimeout: Cabin CO2 scrubber saturation and O2 drop degraded flight crew operations
flight.failure.dockingCollision: Hard docking collar impact outside 25px alignment tolerance drained station power
flight.failure.dockingTimeout: Orbital docking window missed; emergency thruster burn consumed extra propellant
flight.failure.emergencySeparation: Emergency separation triggered with unresolved orbital station crises
